verdict.rationale: Weave is a hosted observability and evaluation service that stores customer traces, inputs and outputs, so a data-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a policy or setting that keeps customer data out of AI model training. PII-detection scorers and trace capture are adjacent features and do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
